department: Faculty of Science — School of Biological Sciences

deadline.value: Main Round and Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS) deadline for 2027-28 entry is December 1, 2026 (1st Clearing Round: April 30, 2027; 2nd Clearing Round: August 31, 2027).

also.quote: In view of the limited admission quota, applicants are strongly encouraged to apply in the Main Round. Applications will be considered in the clearing rounds only if there are vacancies after the Main Round.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for biology (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: School of Biological Sciences strongly recommends identifying and emailing a potential supervisor in Ecology & Biodiversity or Molecular & Cell Biology to check availability and develop a project before applying.
supervisor.quote: Applicants are strongly recommended to browse the web pages of each Research Area: Area of Ecology & Biodiversity and Area of Molecular & Cell Biology to identify a staff member who is carrying out research closest to their interests. You should then contact them by email to ascertain whether the staff member intends to take on a new student this year, and whether you are suitable.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students with 2:1 honours (or equivalent) or above are normally eligible for Postgraduate Scholarships (HK$19,135/month; HK$19,655/month after confirmation, wef 1/9/2026), subject to funding availability, while HKU-PS/HKPF awardees receive HK$28,700/month plus tuition waiver and cash awards.
funding.quote: For non HKU-PS / non-HKPF Research Postgraduate (RPg) students | Postgraduate Scholarship (PGS) | Funding value: HK$19,135/month or HK$19,655/month# (wef 1/9/2026)

also.quote: other full-time PhD and MPhil students who hold a first degree with second-class honours first division (or equivalent) or above are normally considered eligible to receive a Postgraduate Scholarship (PGS) during the normative study period, subject to availability of funding.

entry_route.value: Admits good honours bachelor's and/or taught master's holders to the 4-year PhD, and research master's (e.g., MPhil) holders to the 3-year PhD.
entry_route.quote: The University offers 3-year and 4-year PhD programmes. Applicants who have a good Bachelor’s degree with honours and/or a taught Master’s degree will be considered for admission to a 4-year PhD programme, whereas those who already hold a research Master’s degree (e.g. MPhil) will only be considered for admission to a 3-year PhD programme.

notes: Covers Ecology & Biodiversity and Molecular & Cell Biology.
